title: Add DevExpress build-package workflow to publish nuget
body:
We are already publishing one project (the MacOS Theme) as a nuget, and now we would like to publish a second project (DevExpress Theme). 

I copied the existing workflow script and adjusted - did I miss anything? (see 2. commit for my changes to the existing, working script)

Also, will renaming the existing workflow impact anything but the build history? 

Thanks for any advice!
author: apman

comments.body: @apman I see one problem with the change, but we can refactor after this merge: we now have two publishing workflows, when this repository can only release everything at once (both nugets) for GitHub Releases. There's no problem to merge now and refactor the workflows after, since the new DevExpress package hasn't yet been published, and we can still run the original workflow.
